doc: Reviewed staged surface: exported symbols whose production consumer is deliberately deferred. Each entry names why the surface exists and the work expected to consume it; prune an entry when its trigger lands. Undeclared new unconsumed surface still blocks the gate.

staged.name: NewMutationCheckpointRuntime
staged.reason: Agent-loop mutation checkpointing API delivered by the manifest lane with internals and tests complete.
staged.consumer_trigger: Agent delegation campaign wires checkpointed mutation runs into cmd/agent-loop.

staged.name: NewDelegatedCoordinator
staged.reason: Delegated multi-agent coordination API delivered by the manifest lane.
staged.consumer_trigger: Agent delegation campaign wires coordination into cmd/agent-loop.

staged.name: Compare
staged.reason: API manifest diffing delivered ahead of its gate integration.
staged.consumer_trigger: The gate grows an API-manifest census phase.

staged.name: sameLocalLocation
staged.reason: Location comparison helper landing with the location tightening; its production caller arrives with location dedup.
staged.consumer_trigger: Location dedup consumes local-location comparison.

staged.name: RequireWithin
staged.reason: Shared max-abs-diff tolerance gate consolidating the per-package golden-test copies; test-support surface is test-consumed by design.
staged.consumer_trigger: Permanent test-support owner; retire only if the golden suites stop comparing float tensors.

staged.name: RequireElementsWithin
staged.reason: Shared first-divergent-element tolerance gate consolidating hostmath and seriesforecast golden checks; test-support surface is test-consumed by design.
staged.consumer_trigger: Permanent test-support owner; retire only if the golden suites stop comparing float tensors.

staged.name: ModelArtifactDir
staged.reason: Shared model-directory resolver for artifact-gated golden tests, consolidating the per-package copies; test-support surface is test-consumed by design.
staged.consumer_trigger: Permanent test-support owner; retire only if artifact-gated suites stop resolving model roots.

staged.name: NewEfficiencyTrace
staged.reason: Interaction-efficiency baseline document delivered by redundancy-interaction-baseline/interaction-traces with contract and measured storage baseline complete.
staged.consumer_trigger: interaction-efficiency rows instrument live surfaces and commit their traces through this constructor.

staged.name: ParseEfficiencyTrace
staged.reason: Reader for the interaction-efficiency baseline document; staged with its constructor.
staged.consumer_trigger: interaction-efficiency projection-query-plans reads committed traces for comparison reports.

staged.name: CountingRepository
staged.reason: Shared commit-counting wrapper proving one-batch semantic transitions across runrecord, workflowruntime, and modelrecipe; test-support surface is test-consumed by design.
staged.consumer_trigger: Permanent test-support owner; retire only if the one-commit-per-transition contract is retired.

staged.name: ReadContents
staged.reason: Batched content reader consolidating per-item fan-out reads; consumed by evaluation resume and modelrecipe decision loading.
staged.consumer_trigger: Already consumed in production; entry documents the batch-reader family until interaction-efficiency projections widen it.

staged.name: ContentVisitor
staged.reason: Optional batch-visit capability interface the batched reader detects.
staged.consumer_trigger: Implemented by overgodb.Store; retire if content visiting moves onto the Reader interface.

staged.name: ContentPresence
staged.reason: Optional presence-batch capability interface for mixed evidence lists.
staged.consumer_trigger: Implemented by overgodb.Store; retire if presence moves onto the Reader interface.

staged.name: subscribePublished
staged.reason: Head-publication observer seam delivered by storage-projections/atomic-publication with its atomicity contract complete; live subscribers arrive with head-bound deltas.
staged.consumer_trigger: interaction-efficiency/head-bound-deltas consumes the seam and retires this entry.

staged.name: DocumentStorageClass
staged.reason: Storage-class ownership rule delivered by storage-operational-boundary/storage-classes; consumed by the runrecord contract and next by the transition boundary.
staged.consumer_trigger: storage-operational-boundary/transition-boundary enforces the class at the commit boundary and retires this entry.

staged.name: IsOperationalSignalSchema
staged.reason: Operational-signal shape rule; staged with its class owner.
staged.consumer_trigger: transition-boundary refuses signal schemas at the commit boundary.

staged.name: LayoutStorageClass
staged.reason: Store-layout class rule; staged with its class owner.
staged.consumer_trigger: interaction-efficiency and migration drills classify layout paths through it.

staged.name: StorageClass
staged.reason: Typed class enumeration; staged with its owner functions.
staged.consumer_trigger: transition-boundary consumes the classes at the commit boundary.
